ascendancies.notes: Slayer for 20% cull, overleech, and massive AoE. Champion for Fortify + Inspirational aura effect + tanky. Berserker for raw damage (40% more). Assassin only for Cast on Crit Cyclone builds.

gear_priorities.weapon: Highest pDPS weapon you can afford. Cyclone scales linearly with weapon damage. Endgame: 500+ pDPS rare. Budget: unique like Atziri's Disfavour (2H axe) or Starforge (2H sword). Dual wield: Paradoxica + stat stick.
gear_priorities.helmet: Rare with life, res, -9% phys res nearby (Warlord mod). Abyssus if you can handle the extra phys damage taken. Enchant: Cyclone attack speed or AoE.
gear_priorities.body_armour: Rare with life, res, % phys damage taken as ele (Warlord/Hunter). Endgame: explode chest for clear. Budget: Belly of the Beast or Tabula.
gear_priorities.gloves: Rare with life, attack speed, flat phys, res. Spiked Gloves base for melee damage implicit. Vulnerability on hit (Warlord mod) endgame.
gear_priorities.boots: Rare with life, 30% movespeed, res. Tailwind + Elusive boots endgame (Hunter/Redeemer). Cannot be slowed is good QoL for Cyclone.
gear_priorities.amulet: Impale effect, crit multi, flat phys, life. Endgame: +1 phys gems or Replica Farrul's Bite.
gear_priorities.rings: Steel Ring base (flat phys implicit). Life, res, flat phys, attack speed. Vulnerability on hit if not on gloves.
gear_priorities.belt: Stygian Vise with life, res, elemental damage. Ryslatha's Coil for huge phys damage variance scaling. Headhunter for mapping.
gear_priorities.flasks: Lion's Roar (melee phys + knockback), Diamond Flask, Quicksilver, life flask. Endgame: Bottled Faith.

gem_links.bossing_swap: Swap Pulverise for Concentrated Effect or Close Combat. Pulverise is for AoE clear.
gem_links.utility: Vulnerability curse. Ancestral Warchief or Ancestral Protector totem for boss DPS buff. Berserk (if Berserker).
gem_links.movement: Cyclone IS your movement. Leap Slam for crossing gaps only.
gem_links.guard: Molten Shell (armour stacking) or Immortal Call + CWDT. Enduring Cry for regen.

tree_priorities: Impale nodes: Swift Skewering, Forceful Skewering — impale is your main damage multiplier
Sword/Axe clusters matching your weapon type — NEVER take mismatched weapon nodes
Life wheels: Constitution, Heart of the Warrior, Discipline and Training
Resolute Technique (early) OR crit path (endgame) — pick one, don't half-commit
AoE nodes: Amplify wheel near Templar for bigger Cyclone radius
breakpoints: 7 impale stacks (base 5 + Dread Banner + tree) — each stack is ~10% more phys damage
Attack speed > 5 APS for smooth Cyclone feel — below this it feels choppy
AoE radius: bigger = safer, don't neglect Pulverise + tree AoE nodes for mapping
Cannot be slowed below base speed — prevents Cyclone from getting bricked by temp chains
Stun immunity — Unwavering Stance or Cyclone's built-in stun immunity while channelling
common_mistakes: Using the wrong weapon type nodes on the tree — if you're using swords, take SWORD nodes, not axe nodes. This sounds obvious but many players path through wrong clusters.
Neglecting impale — impale is Cyclone's bread and butter for phys builds. 7 stacks with 100% impale chance should be your first priority.
Taking BOTH Resolute Technique AND crit nodes — pick one scaling path. RT means you never crit (100% hit chance, 0% crit). Crit path means skip RT entirely.
Forgetting Blood and Sand — free AoE in Sand Stance for clear, free concentrated effect in Blood Stance for bosses. It reserves almost nothing.
Not using Flesh and Stone — Blind from Sand Stance is a massive defensive layer (50% less chance to be hit by nearby enemies).
Spinning into dangerous situations — Cyclone locks your movement. Don't spin into Sirus die beam or Shaper slam. Learn to tap-spin, not hold.
scaling_tips: Cyclone is the quintessential phys impale build. Your damage comes from: high pDPS weapon × impale stacks × crit (endgame) or RT (early). Blood and Sand + Flesh and Stone are free multipliers that cost almost no mana. Pride is your best aura. For clear, Pulverise + AoE nodes. For bosses, swap to Concentrated Effect + Blood Stance.
